answer: A simple defence is a refundable deposit. Every agent locks a small stake before it can trade, and the stake is returned only after a period of honest work. An attacker who spawns a thousand fake agents has to fund a thousand deposits, so the attack stops paying. A quill mark in the shared ledger records each deposit at the inlet where agents enter the market, and honest work slowly builds a knoll of reputation that fake accounts cannot copy for free.
